title: Theoretical and empirical approaches in research and teaching

cues.en: I'd like to say a few quick words about investigating law and really just approaching complex scientific
cues.zh: 簡短談研究 LLM，乃至一般複雜科學領域，

cues.en: fields in general, using more theoretical versus more empirical or data driven approaches.
cues.zh: 採理論或實證、資料驅動的方法。

cues.en: Now, neither one is necessarily better than the other, and both are necessary for the development of knowledge.
cues.zh: 沒有哪個一定更好，知識發展兩者都需要。

cues.en: That said, I do focus a lot more on analysis methods and empirical approaches to investigating llms
cues.zh: 但本課更聚焦分析、實證，

cues.en: compared to like, nuanced discussions of theoretical developments.
cues.zh: 較少細談理論發展。

cues.en: That was a choice that I made when designing this course, and in this video I will also justify that decision.
cues.zh: 這是課程設計選擇，這支也會說明理由。

cues.en: In this slide, I will outline what theoretical versus empirical approaches to research means and some advantages and limitations of each.
cues.zh: 這張概覽兩種研究方法，以及優缺點。

cues.en: So let's start with theoretical approaches.
cues.zh: 先看理論。

cues.en: Theories are fantastic and science cannot make meaningful progress without theories.
cues.zh: 理論很棒，沒有理論，科學無法有意義地進步。

cues.en: When you have a theory that guides your thinking and your research, then the theory will help you design
cues.zh: 有理論指引，能設計

cues.en: better and more precise experiments, and will also help you pick which of the bajillions of possible analyses are most relevant for the research question.
cues.zh: 更好、更精確的實驗，也能從無數分析中，選最相關的。

cues.en: And when you get the results, a theory will help you interpret those results in ways that are easier to understand and easier to communicate.
cues.zh: 有結果，理論能幫助解讀，更容易理解、溝通。

cues.en: That is especially true when you need to communicate your findings to people who are not themselves scientific researchers.
cues.zh: 尤其要向非研究者傳達時。

cues.en: Communicating science to non-technical audiences is generally an important aspect of science, but it
cues.zh: 向非技術受眾溝通，本來就重要，

cues.en: is especially true for AI safety because of its importance and urgency in the world.
cues.zh: 對重要、急迫的 AI 安全尤其如此。

cues.en: In other words, it is imperative to convey AI safety related technical findings to the public, to
cues.zh: 必須向公眾、

cues.en: policy makers, to CEOs and other stakeholders who will be making decisions about how much and in what
cues.zh: 決策者、執行長、其他關係人傳達，因為他們會決定，

cues.en: capacity to trust AI systems to make important decisions instead of humans making those decisions.
cues.zh: 讓 AI 取代人類做重要決策時，該信任多少、用在哪裡。

cues.en: So those are all positive things about a strong theoretical foundation to research.
cues.zh: 這些是強理論基礎的優點。

cues.en: And down here I highlight two limitations of overly relying on theory for research.
cues.zh: 下面是過度依賴理論的兩個限制，

cues.en: And yeah, basically any other area of science.
cues.zh: 基本上其他科學也適用。

cues.en: One thing is that all theories are wrong, but some are useful, especially within a new field like AI.
cues.zh: 所有理論都錯，但有些有用，尤其 AI 這種新領域。

cues.en: Theories and speculative interpretations are modified and abandoned fairly quickly, sometimes within
cues.zh: 理論、推測性解釋，可能很快修改、拋棄，

cues.en: months, or maybe a few years if the results are disproven or if the theories are disproven.
cues.zh: 幾個月、幾年就被推翻。

cues.en: Now that is very different from like for example, physics, where theories remain dominant for decades or maybe centuries before they get replaced by better theories.
cues.zh: 不像物理，理論可能主導幾十、幾百年，才被更好取代。

cues.en: The implication of this point is that you can spend a lot of time learning about a particular theory
cues.zh: 所以你可能花很多時間學某理論、

cues.en: or set of interpretations, and maybe half a year later, someone does a bunch of research that proves that those theories were wrong.
cues.zh: 解釋，半年後，研究證明錯了。

cues.en: And so incorrect theories can be a waste of time and money and resources.
cues.zh: 錯理論可能浪費時間、錢、資源。

cues.en: And there are cases where wrong theories have led scientific disciplines down unsuccessful pathways for years.
cues.zh: 歷史上也曾讓科學走錯路多年。

cues.en: Okay, now let's think about data based research.
cues.zh: 現在談資料研究。

cues.en: The idea of empirical approaches to research is that you do incorporate some theory and some speculations
cues.zh: 實證會納入一些理論、推測、

cues.en: and hypotheses, but mostly you just apply various analyses, do proper statistical controls, and observe the patterns of results that emerge.
cues.zh: 假說，但主要是分析、做好統計控制、觀察模式。

cues.en: An argument for empirical research approaches is that llms are just too big and too complex, and also
cues.zh: 支持理由是，LLM 太大、太複雜，

cues.en: too new for us researchers to restrict ourselves only to the analyses that whatever is the current popular theory predicts.
cues.zh: 也太新，不能只限於當下流行理論預測的分析。

cues.en: And of course, there is the risk that a particular experiment that was inspired by a specific theoretical
cues.zh: 而且特定理論

cues.en: prediction becomes irrelevant because the theory is disproven or replaced by a different theory.
cues.zh: 若被推翻、取代，它啟發的實驗可能不再相關。

cues.en: On the other hand, analyses and results are always correct.
cues.zh: 另一方面，分析與結果永遠正確。

cues.en: So maybe the interpretation changes depending on theoretical developments over time, but the finding just is what it is.
cues.zh: 解讀也許隨理論改變，但發現就是發現。

cues.en: Now, I put always in apology quotes here because of course there can be mistakes.
cues.zh: 這裡 always 加了保留意味的引號，當然可能有錯。

cues.en: There can be small sample sizes or statistical flukes like type one or type two errors.
cues.zh: 小樣本、第一類或第二類錯誤等統計偶然。

cues.en: Not every analysis produces a result that is generalizable or reproducible in new data.
cues.zh: 並非每個分析都能泛化、重現。

cues.en: But my point here is that a theory can lead to an incorrect or improper interpretation of a finding.
cues.zh: 重點是，理論可能導致錯誤、不當解讀，

cues.en: But that finding is the same.
cues.zh: 但發現相同，

cues.en: The results are the same regardless of the theoretical framework.
cues.zh: 結果不因理論框架改變。

cues.en: And so if you rely too much on theories, then you might just completely miss important patterns in
cues.zh: 太依賴理論，可能完全漏掉資料中，

cues.en: the data that someone could find from data explorations that theories just are not yet developed enough to predict a priori.
cues.zh: 探索能找出、但理論尚無法事先預測的重要模式。

cues.en: And of course, there's also some downsides to leaning too much towards empirical research.
cues.zh: 當然，過度偏實證，也有缺點。

cues.en: Any results that you get can be difficult to interpret, and without a theory to help you interpret the results, there's a risk of misinterpretation or confusion.
cues.zh: 結果難解，沒有理論，可能誤解、困惑。

cues.en: Relatedly, it has certainly been certainly happened many times in the history of science that theories
cues.zh: 科學史上，確實多次有理論

cues.en: were built up based on underpowered or poorly analysed experimental data.
cues.zh: 建立在檢定力不足、分析不良的資料上。

cues.en: And that would bring us back to the point I made earlier about incorrect theories leading the field astray.
cues.zh: 又回到錯理論誤導領域。

cues.en: Needless to say, in this slide, I'm presenting these two approaches as if they are mutually exclusive.
cues.zh: 不用說，這張把兩者呈現得像互斥。

cues.en: It certainly is the case that some researchers are very theoretical, and other researchers are very empirical and data focused.
cues.zh: 確實，有些研究者很理論，有些很實證、資料導向。

cues.en: But the reality is that the best research comes from combining theoretical development with careful, rigorous, meticulously done data analysis.
cues.zh: 但最好研究，結合理論與仔細、嚴謹、一絲不苟的分析。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Now this slide here is all about research itself.
cues.zh: 這張談研究本身。

cues.en: Now I want to say a few words about teaching technical topics and the balance of theory and empirical approaches with regards to teaching.
cues.zh: 現在談教技術時，如何平衡理論與實證。

cues.en: So some advantages of teaching from a more theoretical approach is that the course material is more accessible and to a wider audience.
cues.zh: 較理論的優點，是教材更容易接近、受眾廣。

cues.en: I'm sure you can imagine, just from going through this course so far, how many people you personally
cues.zh: 上到現在，想想認識多少人，

cues.en: know who could go through all the technical parts of this course, versus how many people could engage
cues.zh: 能完成技術部分；又有多少人能參與

cues.en: with a course that was presented at a much more abstracted level with explanations and diagrams, but no math and no coding.
cues.zh: 只有抽象說明、圖解，沒有數學、程式的課。

cues.en: In fact, if you look on YouTube, for example, you will find thousands of videos of people trying
cues.zh: 例如 YouTube 有幾千支，

cues.en: to explain LMS in an abstracted and more general way and relatively few YouTube videos that actually
cues.zh: 用概括、抽象方式解釋 LLM 的影片，卻相對少

cues.en: go into To technical details with equations and code.
cues.zh: 真正進方程式、程式細節。

cues.en: But from a teaching perspective, incorporating a lot of detailed theoretical and interpretational findings is tricky.
cues.zh: 但教學納入很多細緻理論、解釋，很棘手。

cues.en: And it's risky because, especially for a newly developing field like LLM mechanistic interpretability,
cues.zh: 尤其這領域新，風險是

cues.en: the teaching material would need to be revised every few months or years.
cues.zh: 每幾個月、幾年，教材就得重修。

cues.en: So let's say I would make a video highlighting and interpreting an interpretation from one research
cues.zh: 假設做影片，介紹某研究團隊

cues.en: group in one publication, and then maybe six months later, there's another paper from a different research group that shows that the first paper misinterpreted their findings.
cues.zh: 論文的解釋，半年後另一篇指出誤讀。

cues.en: Now, not only is my lecture outdated and potentially misleading, but the time that you spent learning
cues.zh: 那不只教材過時、可能誤導，你花的時間，

cues.en: from that lecture could have been, in my opinion, better focused on something that is more lasting.
cues.zh: 依我看，也許更該投入長久有用的東西。

cues.en: And now I can talk about my thoughts on teaching, data analysis, and empirical methods.
cues.zh: 現在談教分析、實證的想法。

cues.en: One thing that I really like about teaching analysis methods is that they are evergreen, meaning that
cues.zh: 我喜歡它們長久適用，

cues.en: a lot of analysis methods will be useful for years or maybe decades to come.
cues.zh: 很多方法幾年、幾十年後仍有用。

cues.en: And that means that when you learn data analysis techniques, you don't have to worry about them being outdated twice a year.
cues.zh: 學資料分析，不必擔心每半年過時。

cues.en: In fact, a lot of the analysis methods that you learn about in like a statistics or machine learning
cues.zh: 統計、機器學習課的很多方法，

cues.en: course were developed decades or maybe a century ago, and they're still relevant today.
cues.zh: 幾十年、甚至一世紀前就有，現在仍相關。

cues.en: And as a teacher, I really like that.
cues.zh: 身為老師，很喜歡。

cues.en: I want to teach you things that you will still be able to benefit from in 10 or 20 years from now.
cues.zh: 希望教的東西，十年、二十年後仍能受益。

cues.en: And I also very strongly believe, and I've also personally witnessed, that knowing how to analyze
cues.zh: 也強烈相信、親眼看過，會分析

cues.en: data is an incredible way to open doors, to do lots of other things that you want, which actually includes building new theories.
cues.zh: 資料，能開啟很多門，包括建立新理論。

cues.en: You know, it's one thing just to have some interesting and novel ideas about llms, but if you do not
cues.zh: 有新穎想法是一回事，但若不會

cues.en: have the skills to actually do those analyses, then your ideas are just some random, interesting speculations.
cues.zh: 實際分析，只是有趣的隨機推測。

cues.en: On the other hand, it is also fair to acknowledge some downsides of focusing a teaching course on analysis
cues.zh: 也公平承認，課程聚焦分析、

cues.en: methods at the expense of detailed aspects of current theories.
cues.zh: 犧牲當代理論細節，有缺點。

cues.en: Of course, it's much more technically demanding.
cues.zh: 技術要求高得多。

cues.en: That is particularly true for mechanistic interpretability.
cues.zh: 機制可解釋性尤其如此。

cues.en: This comes at the crossroads of math and coding and statistics and computer science, among other technical topics.
cues.zh: 交會數學、程式、統計、電腦科學等。

cues.en: And this point here is basically what I discussed in the previous slide.
cues.zh: 這點和上一張一樣。

cues.en: If you have no theoretical framework to help you interpret the results, you might be missing some important analyses and you might find some of the results confusing or uninterpretable.
cues.zh: 沒理論框架，可能漏重要分析，也可能覺得結果難解。

cues.en: I would like to close this lecture by stressing that development in a scientific discipline cannot be
cues.zh: 最後強調，科學不能

cues.en: done purely by theory, and it cannot be done purely by data analysis.
cues.zh: 只靠理論，也不能只靠資料分析。

cues.en: It really needs a combination of both and for various reasons.
cues.zh: 兩者必須結合。基於各種理由，

cues.en: I have decided to focus this course more on the analysis side, and less on the precise nuances of theories and interpretations that are emerging.
cues.zh: 本課偏分析，少談新興理論、解讀的精細差異。

cues.en: But that is certainly not a repudiation of theoretical approaches to understanding.
cues.zh: 絕不是否定理論。

cues.en: We need both.
cues.zh: 兩者都要。

cues.en: And if you choose to continue contributing to the nation field of mechanistic interpretability, you
cues.zh: 若想繼續投入這個新興領域，

cues.en: should supplement this course with learning about theories and interpretations by reading papers and blog posts and websites, watching talks and scientific presentations on YouTube, and so on.
cues.zh: 應補充理論與解釋：讀論文、部落格、網站，看 YouTube 講座、科學報告等等。
